**Program Development Life Cycle (PDLC)** (Week 1)

The Program Development Life Cycle (PDLC) is the set of stages a programmer follows to turn a problem into a working program. The stages are: Problem Analysis, Algorithm Design, Coding, Translation and Debugging, Execution and Testing, and Implementation and Maintenance. An algorithm is a finite, ordered list of clear steps that solves a problem. Pseudocode is an algorithm written in simple English-like lines. A flowchart is a diagram of the algorithm made with standard symbols and arrows.
